theme_and_vibe.emotion: Cinematic, urgent, authoritative, highly technical yet accessible

headings.usage: Use Outfit for all H1-H4 headings. Apply 'tracking-tight' for massive H1 headers.

body.usage: Technical body copy, data tables, map tooltips, and dashboard labels.

mono.usage: AI Assessment data points, coordinates, tracking IDs.

crystal_glassmorphism.usage: Top navigation, Floating stat cards, Hero overlay elements.

asphalt_card.usage: Dashboard cards, Report category bento boxes.

ai_scanner_panel.css_classes: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1A1A1A] to-[#0A0A0A] border border-orange-500/30 rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden

water_ripple.effect: Use CSS keyframes to animate a concentric SVG circle expanding and fading (opacity: 0) to simulate water ripples.

rain_effect.concept: Subtle vertical/diagonal moving particles in the Hero background.
rain_effect.implementation: Framer motion absolute divs or a lightweight HTML canvas drawing faint white/gray dashes moving downwards.

gps_pulse.effect: Concentric rings scaling up from 0.5 to 2.0 with opacity fading from 0.8 to 0.

page_scroll_parallax.concept: Simulate moving forward on a road.
page_scroll_parallax.implementation: Use Framer Motion `useScroll` to scale up background road image slightly and translate Y for floating cards.

hero_section.layout: 100vh full-bleed absolute container with the asphalt road background image.
hero_section.overlay: bg-black/60 or a gradient bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-black/40 to-transparent
hero_section.content: Center aligned massive text. H1: 'THE ROAD TELLS A STORY. WE MAKE IT VISIBLE.' (Outfit, text-5xl md:text-7xl, font-bold, tracking-tight).
hero_section.interactive_element: Foreground absolute positioned div containing the pothole image cropped as an organic shape. On hover, trigger ripple animation and show a tooltip 'Pothole Detected - Severity: High'.

identify_road.layout: Split section. Left: Text & CTA 'Identify Road Using GPS' with a pulsing target icon. Right: A dark glass card showing a Leaflet map snapshot with a pulsing orange GPS dot.

report_problem.layout: Bento grid of square cards. 2-3 columns.
report_problem.cards: Each card represents a category (Pothole, Damaged Road, etc.). Use Phosphor icons (e.g., Warning, Path, Drop). Active state turns border to Orange.
report_problem.interaction: Clicking 'Pothole' triggers an animation where a pothole graphic is revealed in the form preview.

ai_assessment.layout: Tech-focused card. Mono-spaced text for metrics. Progress bars for Confidence (94%) and Safety Risk.
ai_assessment.visual: Add a scanning line animation (a horizontal 1px bright orange div moving top to bottom infinitely) over an image thumbnail.

road_profile.layout: Dense data dashboard style. 3-column grid for metrics (Authority, Contractor, Condition).
road_profile.empty_state: Use opacity-50 and italic text 'Data unavailable' with a subtle dash icon.

complaint_timeline.styling: Completed steps: Orange circle, white text. Pending steps: Dark gray circle, muted text. Connecting line is half orange, half dark gray.

dark_map.markers: Custom divIcon with glowing orange CSS shadows.

dashboards.layout: Sidebar navigation (Glassmorphism). Main content area with a masonry or CSS grid layout.
dashboards.cards: Use Shadcn Card component customized with 'asphalt_card' surface specs.

auth_screen.layout: Split screen layout. Left half: 'Login as Administration' (Disabled/Opacity-50). Right half: 'Login as User' (Active form). Background should be the dark road texture.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST use Tailwind CSS for all styling.
Do NOT add a generic 'transition: all'. Use explicit transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors duration-200').
Never use pure black or pure white everywhere. Tint blacks with the primary color (e.g., #0A0A0A) and use off-whites (#FAFAFA) for text.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, link, and major input field.
DO NOT make generic centered layouts. Utilize grids, bento-box layouts, and asymmetric spacing.
Shadcn components must be customized to fit the 'Dark Asphalt / Glassmorphism' theme. Overwrite default white backgrounds in Shadcn Cards to #121212.
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standard). Warning/Orange text on dark backgrounds must be legible.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or navbars.
All interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., slight translateY, box-shadow glow, or color shift).
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, leaflet, react-leaflet, @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react.
